Motion Studio · 15 November 2026 · English

One navigation. Combined safeguards.

PR #67 resolves against the current arcade and Pages mainline while retaining each camera owner's recovery rules.

PR #67 · Issue #63

What changed and why

Resolved nine conflicting files against main 6974c68. Combined imports in all four game viewers, kept Maze's callable blocker for actual calibration and participant-window ownership, retained both Runner startup finally operations, preserved both sets of late-start assertions, and combined current game documentation with the startup policy. Directory verification targets the actual cards/tool links using current relative URLs.

Automatic merging alone would have left the new chooser pointing to root URLs and omitted operator pages on GitHub Pages. Navigation now preserves the project directory, detects its current page (including index.html), and offers only the five shipped static destinations in Pages mode. The local build retains all seven destinations. Tests cover both modes and blocked project-path departures.

Current main's multiplayer, spectator recovery, camera preview, calibrated Runner lanes and UI effects remain present. No game engine, session, vision, schema, dependency or distributable changes are included in this PR's diff against main. Source queues and ownership attribution are unchanged.

Actual checks

pnpm check passed: 970 Vitest tests, 314 pytest tests, contracts, types, lint, formatting and repository conventions; pnpm build passed: seven entries and emitted asset references; production directory/browser checks passed at desktop/mobile/320px; pnpm build:pages and pnpm verify:pages passed: five static entries, four rounds per desktop/mobile viewport, project-path chooser links and directory return, zero API or asset errors

Installed headless Chromium 157.0.4341.42 through real Vite: all seven routes at 1440×1000, 390×844 and 320×740; measured viewport width and no page overflow. The before snapshot loads TypeScript from immutable main 6974c68 with the same current theme. The after snapshot shows Switch view expanded. All navigation runs reported zero uncaught page errors.

  • Real Vite server: all seven routes captured at 1440×1000, 390×844 and 320×740, English; no camera/service used
  • Keyboard Enter opens, Tab reaches first game, Escape closes and returns focus
  • Synthetic source departure blocked; failed scoped Stop retained Retry; acknowledged retry allowed directory return
  • Calibration-style app-local ownership veto keeps Maze on its operator page
  • Actual Maze calibration: pending cancellation, failed late scoped release, retry recovery and unknown successful ownership all preserve departure barriers
  • Separate participant window contains the same game stage and no operator navigation; departure waits for its return/close

Acquisition: 6 desktop/mobile game cases passed. Forced Start after Stop sent exactly one acquisition request while its earlier acknowledgement was pending; failed late release kept retry and locks; acknowledged retry enabled an explicit replacement; malformed successful ownership retained restart/reload guidance. All HTTP/WebSocket boundaries are synthetic, with no camera or vision service.

Integration boundaryVerified behavior
RunnerBoth pendingStarts and NavigationStartup survive cancellation; finally removes the generation and finishes navigation ownership. Preview, standing reference and current recovery tests remain.
MazeThe actual controller blocks departure through pending cancellation, failed late scoped release and unknown success. A successful retry permits navigation; participant windows remain a separate blocker.
Local and Pages navigationAccessible current location, Enter/Tab/Escape, relative links, directory index alias and mode-specific destinations. Navigation never acquires a camera or transfers a score.
Hosted merge gateRequire this revision's software-checks and Pages build before merging. Local checks do not pre-claim hosted results.

Remaining limits

Windows; Node 24.16.0, pnpm 11.25.0, isolated Python 3.12.16. Hosted CI pins Node 24.21.0 and runs Ubuntu, Windows and macOS. Tests, builds and browser verification run serially. The existing large Runner chunk warning remains. Camera drivers, hardware/GPU capacity, physical calibration accuracy, participant tracking and action-to-display latency were not tested.

App links preserve the owner page and its recovery controls. Browser Back, address-bar changes, tab close and OS shutdown still use best-effort cleanup; ordinary new-tab links do not transfer ownership. Physical maze gameplay remains gated. The earlier standalone report is a historical snapshot, including its older counts and unmerged-calibration limitation.

Reproduce: node scripts/verify-operator-navigation.mjs --baseline; the same command without --baseline; node scripts/verify-game-acquisition.mjs; the same with --runner; pnpm check; pnpm build; pnpm build:pages; pnpm verify:pages; node scripts/pr67-integration-report.mjs; node scripts/verify-operator-navigation.mjs --report-only. Source media and CSS are embedded for offline use. No participant footage, private device identifiers or credentials are included.
